design_gotchas.title: CRITICAL E vs. ER Suffix Pinout Trap — AP7361C-33E-13 is INCOMPATIBLE with 1117 Pads
design_gotchas.detail: 300 DPI Vision inspection of p.1 and p.15 confirms AP7361C-33E-13 ('E' = SOT223) has Pin 1=IN, Pin 2/Tab=GND, Pin 3=OUT, which shorts VOUT to GND on standard 1117 footprints (1=GND, 2/Tab=VOUT, 3=VIN)! To drop onto a 1117 footprint, you MUST order the 'ER' (SOT223R) suffix (AP7361C-33ER-13), which maps 1=GND, 2/Tab=OUT, 3=IN.

design_gotchas.title: Strict 6.0 V Operating / 6.5 V Abs-Max VIN Limit — Never Connect to 12 V Rails
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike 15 V–26 V bipolar SOT-223 regulators (AMS1117, LM1117, LM2937), AP7361C is a low-voltage CMOS LDO limited to 6.0 V recommended / 6.5 V absolute maximum VIN (p.4). Applying a 12 V supply immediately destroys the regulator.

design_gotchas.title: No Enable (EN) Shutdown Pin on SOT223 Package & 1.1 W Thermal Dissipation Ceiling
design_gotchas.detail: Although the AP7361C datasheet lists 0.05 uA shutdown current on p.5, Section 'Enable' (p.11) clarifies that the EN pin is unavailable in the 3-pin SOT223 package (so ishdn_typ_ua is N/A). At 5.0 V->3.3 V and 1.0 A (1.7 W), SOT223 exceeds its 1.1 W rating (p.4) and 110°C/W bare-pad θJA (p.6) without heavy GND-plane heatsinking.

design_gotchas.title: Minor Datasheet Discrepancy on Dropout (340 mV EC Table vs. 360 mV Front Page) & No Noise Spec
design_gotchas.detail: Page 1 Features cites 360 mV typical dropout at 1 A, whereas the Electrical Characteristics table (p.5) specifies 340 mV typ / 480 mV max for 2.6–3.3 V outputs; design against the 480 mV max figure. Note also that DS37274 publishes no integrated output noise specification.

typical_use_cases: High-efficiency 5 V or 3.8 V to 3.3 V up-to-1 A CMOS rails with ultra-low 60 uA quiescent current
Pin-compatible low-VIN, low-IQ, MLCC-stable candidate drop-in on 78xx / LM2937 SOT-223 (1=IN, 2/Tab=GND, 3=OUT) footprints when VIN <= 6.0 V
Compact 1 A post-regulation after a 3.8 V–5.0 V buck converter requiring 75 dB PSRR and 2.2 uF MLCCs
Modern CMOS 3.3 V power rail with GND-referenced thermal tab for cleaner EMI shielding and ground heatsinking
engineering_summary: The Diodes Incorporated AP7361C-33E-13 is a modern 1.0 A CMOS LDO in SOT-223-3 (SOT223 / E suffix) delivering 60 uA quiescent current, 340 mV typ dropout at 1 A, 75 dB PSRR, and 0–10 ohm ceramic-cap stability (>= 2.2 uF). CRITICAL: the 'E' suffix has Pin 1=IN, Pin 2/Tab=GND, Pin 3=OUT (matching LM2937, NOT 1117—use 'ER' AP7361C-33ER-13 for 1117 footprints). It is an excellent low-dropout, low-IQ candidate drop-in for GND-tab SOT-223 pads once engineers verify VIN <= 6.0 V, no-EN-pin behavior, and 1.1 W thermal limits before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.1 and p.15 definitively confirmed SOT223 (E suffix) pinout (1=IN, 2/Tab=GND, 3=OUT) vs SOT223R (ER suffix) 1117 pinout (1=GND, 2/Tab=OUT, 3=IN).
300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.4 and p.6 confirmed VIN abs max=6.5 V, Rec Op 2.2-6.0 V / 1.0 A / TA=-40 to +85°C, PD=1100 mW, TJ=+150°C, and SOT223 θJA=110°C/W.
300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.12 confirmed 0 to 10 ohm ceramic ESR stability across 0-1000 mA; ishdn_typ_ua (no EN on SOT223, p.11) and output_noise_uvrms (not published) honestly left null.
